No blocking finding. The change touches only documentation (`reports/corpus-replay.md`).

**Is the new sentence true?** Yes. It is at `.review/head/reports/corpus-replay.md:13-14`: "The last two columns hold the verdict the recording carries for that syscall and the verdict `revision/entry` gives for it." The table header at `.review/head/reports/corpus-replay.md:5` is `trace | record | syscall | recorded | revision/entry`, so the last two columns are `recorded` and `revision/entry`.

A possible wording change, not needed: the verdict belongs to one record (the `record` column, e.g. "1 of 2"), not to the syscall in general. A trace can hold several calls to the same syscall. "for that record" would be more exact than "for that syscall".

**Left to a maintainer.** The pull request body says the change is "not for merge" and is opened to record which CI jobs a prose-only change starts. Whether to close or merge it is for a maintainer to decide.
